semantics.note: identity matching here verifies a REGISTERED APPROVER IDENTIFIER (who the approval record claims to act for matches the registry). It is NOT independent identity authentication: there is no cryptographic identity proof, PKI, or external IdP. This pilot runs under a TRUSTED LOCAL EXECUTION ENVIRONMENT premise; no operational-security-grade authentication is provided or claimed.
semantics.binding: the approval record additionally binds invocation id, scope (workstream, call_type, paper_ids) and its file digest into the permit
